notes: The marginal alternative for sittest was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
even is taken as the ASV's word for the resuming הוּא rather than as an addition; the alternative, which leaves הוּא unrepresented and marks even added, is named in that unit's note (rule 8).
יֹשֵׁב follows the noun it modifies and no subject pronoun stands in its clause, so the supplied relative stays with the attributive (rule 41).
לְבַדְּךָ here writes a pronoun of its own, thou, so the suffix is aligned separately from the fused לְבַד → alone (rules 30, 18).
